routes.name: Gabon e-Visa
routes.summary: Gabon has an online e-visa for people arriving by air through Libreville's Leon Mba airport. Apply on the official portal.

other: Air arrivals only for now, via Leon Mba International Airport.
Eligible nationalities, fees and validity not confirmed. The portal blocked automated reading.

routes.name: Short-stay visa (court sejour)
routes.summary: A visa for up to 90 days, single or multiple entry, from a Gabonese embassy or consulate. Some nationalities are exempt. See the official list.

other: Passport valid at least 3 months beyond the stay.
Two photos, signed form, proof of purpose of trip (hotel booking or invitation) and proof of enough funds.
Exempt country list and fees not confirmed. Page also says visas cannot exceed 3 months, so confirm with the embassy.

routes.processing: Up to about two weeks, per the foreign ministry.

routes.name: Long-stay visa and residence card
routes.summary: For stays over 90 days. Embassies and consulates do not issue these. After arrival you must apply for a residence card at the immigration agency (DGDI) within one month.

other: Specific routes (work, family, study), fees and income rules not confirmed. Check dgdi.ga.

routes.processing: About 15 days per the foreign ministry.
